title: Sam Altman says OpenAI's decision to pace its AI development was caused by a collection of research observations showing "various degrees of misalignment" (Alex Heath/Time)
summary: Alex Heath / Time: Sam Altman says OpenAI's decision to pace its AI development was caused by a collection of research observations showing “various degrees of misalignment” — “I think it is a good time to slow down,” OpenAI CEO Sam Altman told me last week, describing the company's decision …
contentText:
Alex Heath / Time :

Sam Altman says OpenAI's decision to pace its AI development was caused by a collection of research observations showing “various degrees of misalignment”   —  “I think it is a good time to slow down,” OpenAI CEO Sam Altman told me last week, describing the company's decision …
